verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own number provisioning beyond one country: it offers Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers in addition to new local or toll-free numbers per user. The evidence shows only US/Canada coverage, and nothing states any country's documentation or regulatory requirements up front. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported countries beyond the US and Canada, per-country documentation/regulatory requirements stated before purchase, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front

citations.quote: Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere, with unlimited calls and texts to the US and Canada.
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
